files.content:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from app.routes.users import router as users_router

app = FastAPI(title="Campus API")
app.include_router(users_router, prefix="/users")

SELECT u.name, COUNT(e.id) AS event_count
FROM users AS u
LEFT JOIN registrations AS r ON r.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN events AS e ON e.id = r.event_id
GROUP BY u.id, u.name
ORDER BY event_count DESC, u.name ASC;

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_user_returns_201():
    payload = {"name": "Asha", "email": "asha@example.com"}
    response = client.post("/users/", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 201
    assert response.json()["email"] == "asha@example.com"

FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
COPY app app
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
